children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retest support at 4,466 ringgit per metric ton, with a good chance of breaking below it and falling into the 4,399-4,440 ringgit range.
The downtrend from 4,852 ringgit has developed below a falling channel. A duplicated channel points at a target zone of 4,357-4,373 ringgit.
A realistic target is 4,440 ringgit. The projection analysis of the fall from 4,833 ringgit shows the contract has pierced below the 338.2% level of 4,466 ringgit. It may fall to 4,440 ringgit.
Resistance is at 4,507 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain into the 4,533-4,549 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the contract has broken a key support at 4,505 ringgit.
The break confirmed an extension of wave c towards 4,292 ringgit, its 100% projection level. The break will be considered false if the market closes above 4,505 ringgit on Thursday.
